overview: This Senate resolution celebrates the friendship between the United States and Denmark on the occasion of Danish Constitution Day, a national holiday in Denmark. It notes the two countries have had diplomatic relations since 1801, that Denmark is a founding member of NATO (the North Atlantic Treaty Organization, a Western military alliance), and that Danish troops have fought alongside U.S. forces in places such as the Gulf War and Afghanistan. It also highlights Denmark's investment in the U.S. economy and its role in the F-35 fighter jet program. The resolution thanks Danes who served in battle and looks ahead to continued cooperation. The Senate agreed to it on July 23, 2025.
for: Supporters say it reaffirms a close ally and NATO partner at a time when strong alliances matter, and recognizes real sacrifices Danish forces have made alongside Americans.
against: Critics say it is symbolic and does not change any law, treaty or spending.
